settings.question: What is Craftmix?
settings.answer: Craftmix is a low sugar, low calorie cocktail mix that comes in a dry blend. Each packet has only 25 calories and 5 grams of sugar, allowing you to enjoy happy hour.

settings.question: How do I make a Craftmix cocktail?
settings.answer: Start with 1 oz of your favorite spirit (optional), add 4 oz of sparkling or still water, mix in one Craftmix packet thoroughly, serve over ice, and enjoy!

settings.question: Can I enjoy Craftmix without alcohol?
settings.answer: Yes! Simply substitute the 1 oz of liquor with an additional 1 oz of sparkling water to create a delicious mocktail.

settings.question: Where is Craftmix manufactured?
settings.answer: All Craftmix products are proudly made in the USA.

settings.question: Does Craftmix expire?
settings.answer: While the dry blend is stable, it's recommended to consume Craftmix within 2 years of manufacture date for maximum freshness.

settings.question: Is Craftmix healthier than liquid cocktail mixes?
settings.answer: Yes. Traditional liquid cocktail mixes often have over 150 calories and 30 grams of sugar due to high-sugar syrups and artificial chemicals. Craftmix avoids that by dehydrating real fruit and concentrating it into delicious blends.

settings.question: Why does Craftmix have a small amount of sugar?
settings.answer: Sugar helps flavors dissolve better and gives cocktails a more balanced taste and texture. Craftmix uses natural sugar, amounting to only about 1/8th of what standard cocktail mixes use.

settings.question: Does Craftmix work with my diet?
settings.answer: Most likely, yes! Craftmix products are all-natural, low calorie, low sugar, low carb, Non-GMO, dairy-free, fat-free, soy-free, gluten-free, cholesterol-free, vegetarian, vegan, paleo, and keto-friendly.

settings.question: How many calories and how much sugar does Craftmix have?
settings.answer: Each packet contains only 25 calories and 5 grams of sugar.

settings.question: What ingredients are used in Craftmix?
settings.answer: Craftmix uses real fruit juice powders and natural ingredients, ensuring a flavorful and health-conscious cocktail experience.

settings.question: When will my order be shipped?
settings.answer: Orders are processed promptly and will be shipped the next business day after confirmation.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Craftmix accepts returns on unopened 12 packs (sealed pouches containing individual packets) if you're unsatisfied with your purchase.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes, free shipping is unlocked for orders over $40.

settings.question: Where can I purchase Craftmix products?
settings.answer: Craftmix products are available here on our website and at retailers like Walmart, Market District, PopShelf, JetBlue, QVC, and 1200+ independent stores across the US.

settings.question: How can I contact Craftmix?
settings.answer: For any questions, comments, or concerns, you can email Craftmix at info@craftmix.com.

settings.question: Do you offer a subscription service?
settings.answer: Yes, Craftmix offers a subscription service through the Craftmix Club, allowing you to receive products at regular intervals with discounts.

settings.question: How do I manage my subscription?
settings.answer: You can manage your subscription by logging into your account on the Craftmix website and adjusting your preferences.

settings.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
settings.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings.

settings.question: Are there any benefits to subscribing?
settings.answer: Subscribers receive discounts on their orders and the convenience of regular deliveries.
